svg.title: Three calls of one compiled echo
svg.desc: Three timelines of the echo kernel on a drive and a readout line, one per call of the compiled kernel: an x90 pulse, a wait, an x180 pulse, a wait, an x90 pulse, then the start of the 500 ns readout, which runs past the right edge at 325 ns. tau = 0 ns: no wait, readout from 60 ns; tau = 100.1 ns: two waits of 50 ns, readout from 160 ns; tau = 200.2 ns: two waits of 100 ns, readout from 260 ns. The x180 pulse's Q quadrature is drawn dashed.
